purpose: Prevent a repeat of E_reason V1, where C1 and C2 had too little admissible feature variation to identify incremental reasoning value.

feature_B_candidates.selection_rule: Use if it passes the same historical coverage/support gates in both transitions.

selection_rule: Evaluate feature_B candidates in priority order. Selection depends only on preregistered data-power pass/fail, never on election outcome or predictive score.

terminal_states.PASS_REASONER_POWER: Two independently varying feature families pass data power and joint identifiability in both transitions; a separate immutable E_reason V2 model/reasoner specification may then be frozen.
terminal_states.FAIL_REASONER_POWER: Data may be useful for a deterministic model, but C1-vs-C2 reasoning contrast remains structurally underidentified; do not invoke an LLM treatment.
terminal_states.DATA_INSUFFICIENT: Second feature family cannot achieve the frozen coverage/support gate without unresolved identities or missingness.
